description: Saves the status and an optional short summary for one step of a Setup Audit run on atilab.io, and returns the run's progress and the next step's id and title. Saving a step again replaces its earlier status and summary. The summary is shown on the run's private progress page.

run_id.description: The run id returned by atilab_audit_start.

status.description: done: the step is finished. skipped: the step was left out. blocked: the step cannot be finished yet.

step_id.description: The step to save, as module.step, e.g. "check.session".

summary.description: Optional, up to 400 characters: what was decided or built in this step. No personal data, client names or credentials.

name: atilab_audit_save_step
title: Save a Setup Audit step
